{{Top|leg}}
'''Flash blind''' was a temporary condition suffered when individuals were exposed to bright lights, such as explosions, that overloaded their visual cortex. [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighters]] employed materials such as phototropic [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] in [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] canopies which automatically darkened in the presence of bright lights to avoid [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] being rendered flash blind.<ref name="JH">''[[Jedi's Honor]]''</ref>
